title: Reproducibility archive for study-held-out benchmarking of BulkFormer representations in skeletal-muscle age prediction
description: Code, frozen analysis intermediates, predictions, tables, figures, audit evidence and a clean-room recomputation entry point for an eight-study, 267-participant benchmark of BulkFormer mean-pooled representations for skeletal-muscle chronological-age prediction.
